name: Wellness Smoothies
instructions: Rotate your smoothie ingredients through the week (different fruits, greens, and add-ins) to widen the range of nutrients you get, not just repeat the same one.
Add a source of healthy fat (chia seeds, flax, half an avocado) to help absorb fat-soluble vitamins from the fruit and greens.
Taste before adding sweetener -- ripe fruit is often sweet enough on its own.
Watch today's video for five smoothie recipes built around wellness and recovery.
